title: Professional Certificate Course in Understanding Sales and Supply Chain Management
description: The aim of a course is to provide students with an understanding of the processes and activities involved in managing the flow of goods and services from suppliers to customers.
longDescription: Learn how Sales Management is carried out during different business cycles. Understand the whole mechanism of Supply chain Management and its practical implications. Understand the Management Information System, its different tools and the difference between MIS and IT. A course aims to provide students with an understanding of the processes and activities involved in managing the flow of goods and services from suppliers to customers. The course typically covers the entire supply chain, including procurement, production, transportation, warehousing, distribution, and customer service. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
courseDetails: The primary goal of a course on Supply Chain Management is to equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to design, implement, and optimize supply chain systems. By understanding the various components of a supply chain and the interrelationships between them, students can develop a holistic view of how supply chains operate and how they can be improved.
